description: Heterogeneous Traffic Count Dataset, Pune (Jan 2023) is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Ashwini Matange, Jibi Abraham. This dataset provides directional, vehicle-class-wise traffic counts derived from real-time CCTV footage recorded at three signalized intersections in Pune, Maharashtra, India (Alankar Chowk, Jehangir Chowk, and RTO Chowk) over a continuous seven-day period from 11 to 18 January 2023. Coverage: national (IN); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
